subject: English
question_text: Fill in the blanks with the words from the box. You may need to change the forms of
stimulus: some of the words. You may need to use one word more than once. 1×10=10 information the about conscious a of for without with on Newspaper reading is a good habit. In the morning we eagerly wait (a) ______ a newspaper. We can not have our breakfast (b) ______ a newspaper of the day. We cannot do a single day without newspaper. It is (c) ______ part and parcel of our day to day life. Newspaper is (d) ______ great use to us. It serves the purpose of people of different sections. It acquaints us with the whole world. We get all sorts of (e) ______ in the newspapers. Through newspapers we come to know what is going (f) ______ in the world around us. By reading newspaper we know (g) ______ politics, economics, culture, literature, games and sports of (h) ______ whole world. Newspaper reading makes a man (i) ______. By reading newspaper a man can keep pace (j) ______ time.
guide_solution: (a) for (b) without (c) a (d) of (e) information (f) on (g) about (h) the (i) conscious (j) with
